all.mapped_by: hand, from the household pilot's core_kind 'tcn_w'
all.why: 'tcn' is the dilated causal residual Conv1D family of 'fused_branches', the inline family closest to the pilot's tcn_w core

core.why: the household pilot's core is 'tcn_w' in native df_e1 code, which no predictor.plugins entry point names; the declared plugin closest to it is 'fused_branches' with one branch and its 'tcn' encoder

grouping.why: the baseline_hand grouping shape -- one block -- holding the columns the search selected; the cut k is not a gene of this space

why.features: none: this search adds no derived or calendar feature, only chooses among the file's own columns
why.lags: searched: a subset of the design job's motivated lags, each no longer than the window
why.transform: searched: one of the transforms the representation schema declares
why.windows: searched: the window is a gene of the declared space, bounded by the sealing window

why: WP06 stage 5: the searched representation 'searched_b05e0334316d', fitted with the rest of the pipeline held at exactly what the baseline_hand stage uses (the same core, the same encoder, no per-feature preprocessor declared, the same epochs, patience, seed, batch size and deterministic ops). The representation is the only thing that differs from the baseline, and the only thing a difference in the table can be attributed to. The budget of this search is 120 genomes drawn for generation 0 and 24 individuals for each of the 5 generations after it, at most 80 fits dispatched; every legal point is fitted once and every refused point is counted and never fitted.
